stem.text: The diagram illustrates the enthalpy changes of a set of reactions

stem.alt: Enthalpy cycle: R to S with ΔH = −134 kJ mol−1 (top); S to U with ΔH = +92 kJ mol−1 (right side); R to T (left side, no value given); T to U with ΔH = −75 kJ mol−1 (bottom).

items: The enthalpy change for the transformation $\text{U} \rightarrow \text{R}$ is $+42\ \text{kJ mol}^{-1}$.
The enthalpy change for the transformation $\text{T} \rightarrow \text{S}$ is endothermic.
The enthalpy change for the transformation $\text{R} \rightarrow \text{T}$ is $-33\ \text{kJ mol}^{-1}$.
